extracted: About 25% of the Western classical playlist's tracks were also used in the overtone playlist, mostly near the start and end of sessions; about 60 minutes of music each participant had chosen before the first session was played in all their sessions from roughly 4 hours after psilocybin, except for one participant, who chose not to provide any; after the first 3 participants three tracks were removed from the overtone playlist and the order slightly adjusted (note 22). Authors' limitations: small sample, no measure of the musical experience such as liking other than the final choice, partial overlap of the playlists, and an open-label design.
